Continuum Dubplate / integrated transport revision. One master BPM, origin and scheduler drive Mosaic, Kinetic rhythm, pitched note roll, live pad loop and Sabre. Dry cut leaves sends open; Mute cuts dry and sends. Native local effects remain intentional source processing; host echo and spring are additional sends. Final meters follow Kill Output. The master limiter is the last protection stage. MIDI is focused to the open instrument; note releases return to the instrument that received the note-on.
